title: Apply for an unregistered vehicle permit
summary: An unregistered vehicle permit (UVP) allows you to drive an unregistered vehicle for a specific journey on the most direct route.
intro:
An unregistered vehicle permit (UVP) allows you to drive an unregistered vehicle for a specific journey. It is only valid for the time required to complete that journey by the most direct route.

Note: If you're an overseas or interstate visitor, you need to visit a Service NSW Centre before you apply for the UVP, so you can be issued a customer number. Take your proof of identity documents with you when you visit the service centre.
who_can_apply: Written-off vehicles are not eligible for UVPs.
Visit Transport for NSW for more information on what vehicles and journeys are eligible.
what_you_need: The required PDF forms (e.g., Safe Use Declaration and Application for Unregistered Vehicle Permit).

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for an Unregistered Vehicle Permit (UVP)?
faqs.a: Written-off vehicles are not eligible for UVPs. For more information on eligible vehicles and journeys, visit Transport for NSW.

faqs.q: What do overseas or interstate visitors need to do before applying for a UVP?
faqs.a: Overseas or interstate visitors must visit a Service NSW Centre first to be issued a customer number. Remember to bring your proof of identity documents.

faqs.q: How do I apply for an Unregistered Vehicle Permit?
faqs.a: You must download and complete the required PDF forms, gather all necessary documentation (including proof of identity and old number plates), and then lodge your application in person at a Service NSW Centre.
